scripts.prepare:bundle-resources: mkdir -p src-tauri/bundled && cp ../../target/release/octomonitor-server src-tauri/bundled/octomonitor-server && chmod +x src-tauri/bundled/octomonitor-server
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server && cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.tauri:build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run prepare:bundle-resources && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --no-sign
